title: Signed exact structure on native closed derived Hom
statement: Let C be a closed braided monoidal Grothendieck abelian category with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions. On its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with the canonical K-flat derived tensor and its right adjoint internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], fix M. The contravariant functor H(K)=RHom(K,M) admits a coherent integer-shift structure which is triangulated. Its degree-n commutation map is (-1)^(n(n+1)/2) times the source-Hom shift adjoint to the total-tensor shift K[-n] tensor L -> (K tensor L)[-n], transported through -(-n)=n. This specifies all integer shifts, not merely the objects or the existence of a third triangle arrow.

source.place: Tags 08J9 and 08JC; signed internal Hom and its evaluation transpose, as expanded in steps 1--6 of lem-sf-site-hom-comparison-thick.

proof.text: Prove naturality of the raw source-shift mate by tensor-shift naturality, conjugateEquiv_whiskerLeft and conjugateEquiv_comp. Transport through -(-n)=n and multiply by the common quadratic scalar to obtain natural signed components. This calculation is implemented by the private naturality helpers, without a new assumption.

Form a natural isomorphism for each integer using exactly the scalar multiple of siteHomOppositeSourceShift. The zero and addition component equations of lem-sf-native-hom-signed-shift-laws prove CommShift.isoZero and isoAdd by extensionality. Thus all maps of the resulting CommShift structure are fixed explicitly.

For an arbitrary distinguished triangle of the triangulated opposite, use mem_distTriang_op_iff to present it by a distinguished original triangle, then DerivedCategory.mem_distTriang_iff to present the latter by a localized ordinary cone. The normalized cone-boundary lemma proves that exact image distinguished. Apply H.mapTriangle to the composite presenting isomorphism and transport distinguishedness. Every integer shift component has the desired formula definitionally.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean assembly with proved mate naturality, reduced to the zero/addition equations and the normalized ordinary cone-boundary calculation. A decomposition, not a completed signed exactness proof.

from.place: Signed exact structure on native closed derived Hom

lean.statement:
theorem nativeDerivedHom_signed_exact
    {C : Type d} [Category.{u + 1} C] [Abelian C]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} C] [MonoidalCategory C]
    [MonoidalPreadditive C] [MonoidalClosed C] [BraidedCategory C]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution C] (M : DerivedCategory C) :
    let H := MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj M
    ∃ s : H.CommShift ℤ,
      (fun [_s : H.CommShift ℤ] ↦ H.IsTriangulated ∧
        ∀ (K : DerivedCategory C) (n : ℤ),
          (H.commShiftIso n).hom.app (op K) =
            (n * (n + 1) / 2).negOnePow •
              (siteHomOppositeSourceShift K n).hom.app M) (_s := s)
lean.note: The original theorem signature is unchanged. The three existing shifts move verbatim to NativeHomSignedShiftLaws, publicly reexported here. Explicit private isomorphisms and CommShift data are constructed from the equations; no arbitrary witness is chosen.
